about_the_game:
This game is one of the best possible ways of wasting money, since it is so random, I'm not sure why'd you want to play this game. Luckily for us all, buying this game also cures boredom.

Features Include :
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

  • You meet some people that I think you'll like a lot :)

  • You get to go to the moon and verify whether the moon landing was fake or not.

  • Run with a sharp object

  • Play baseball with a baguette

  • Battle a French man

  • Become a productive member of society

  • Chill with your boys in Florida

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Synopsis :

Project: Shinova is a RPG Indie game where Quill, a boy from an alternate universe from which we exist in, is taken from his quaint fantasy village and thrust into a meadow where a stone and wooden tower resides. Upon entering, he has found himself within a grand town. Then, draws a legendary sword and propels into a journey of extraordinary heights where he meets a wide cast of characters and assembles a team from those. With the ultimate goal of someday returning home.
 
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Well? I told you this game is random...

I wonder how we even came up with this, and the amount of stupid things we decided to add might boost the game's rating but we'll see.

I really hope there isn't some deep themes in this game because then I'll have to add on top of it for the next few games.

sigh

short_description: A silly, barely-funded RPG Indie game where a boy fights to save all of reality because everyone else is too lazy to do so. You can battle with a very innovative battle system as well. Oh, and you meet some very lovable Mexican robots and baguette squeakers among others.
